title: deps(plugin-auth): lift the better-auth family from 1.7.3 to 1.7.12 — security fixes published after the 2026-10-01 deferral
body:
Filing-gate class: ③ directed task.
Acting reader: the triage seat grades this card (domain / area / priority); the seat it names dispatches one `os-dev` to land the lift as one PR.
Dedup (open and closed): semantic `better-auth security advisory magic link OAuth state oauth-provider consent upgrade 1.7.12` gave 4 hits and `bump better-auth family 1.7.4 1.7.7 1.7.12 upgrade` gave 5. All are closed and none is in scope. The last family move was #17454 (to 1.7.3, via #17440). #21094 deferred the next one (below).
Filed from session `session_01GMBuQthe2LLGteJbhzXhvF`.

## Request (verbatim)

> 单独开一个 issue，把全家升到 1.7.12

## Why now: the 2026-10-01 deferral measured 1.7.6, not the fixes

#21094 recorded the maintainer's deferral, verbatim:

> 按你的推荐:关掉21029立卡,better-auth先放着,21024授权你落地

That deferral covered Dependabot #21029, which proposed **1.7.6**. The critical fix below first ships in **1.7.7**, published 2026-09-30. The other fixes listed below land in 1.7.8 to 1.7.12. None of them was in front of that decision. The maintainer decides whether this card overrides it, and triage should put that question to them before dispatch.

## What 1.7.4 to 1.7.12 fixes, read against what plugin-auth mounts

Read on `origin/main` 1862d8d.

### Advisories

| Advisory | Fixed in | Exposure here |
|---|---|---|
| GHSA-965c-763c-88jm (critical): an OAuth state value is accepted as a Magic Link token | 1.7.7 | **Conditional.** Preconditions per the advisory: Magic Link on with plain token storage (the plugin default), at least one social or Generic OAuth provider, and database-backed OAuth state (the default when a database is configured). `magicLink` is opt-in: `pluginConfig.magicLink ?? false` in `auth-manager.ts`. plugin-auth sets none of `storeToken`, `storeStateStrategy` or `storeIdentifier`, so a deployment that enables `magicLink` alongside `socialProviders` or `oidcProviders` meets every precondition. The cloud repo's source does not enable `magicLink`; its live config is unmeasured. |
| GHSA-r4xp-prcw-77qf (high): OAuth Proxy | 1.7.7 | Not exposed: plugin-auth mounts no `oauthProxy`. |
| GHSA-mx9r-x6ww-qjw9 (high): personal SSO providers | `@better-auth/sso` 1.7.3 | Already fixed at the current pin. |
| GHSA-q84f-53jg-9ppm (high): device approval | 1.7.0-rc.3 | Already fixed at the current pin. |

### Changelog security fixes in packages we mount

- **`@better-auth/oauth-provider`** (mounted when `resolveOidcProviderEnabled` says so; it follows `OS_MCP_SERVER_ENABLED`):
  - better-auth/better-auth#11801 (1.7.10): approving consent without a reference id no longer overwrites an organization's stored consent, which could grant scopes without a prompt.
  - better-auth/better-auth#11830 (1.7.11): a CIMD metadata refresh no longer reverts admin changes made during the fetch (disabled client, `skipConsent`, scopes).
  - better-auth/better-auth#11815 (1.7.10): device-code refresh across approved resources.
  - better-auth/better-auth#11625 (1.7.8): replay protection under `generateId: "uuid"`. plugin-auth sets no `generateId`, but the dev should confirm which IDs the adapter actually generates.
  - better-auth/better-auth#11176, better-auth/better-auth#11596 and better-auth/better-auth#11724 (1.7.10): client-auth, invalid-JWT and PKCE error handling.
- **`@better-auth/sso`**:
  - better-auth/better-auth#11935 (1.7.12): OIDC ID tokens without `exp` / `iat` are refused.
  - better-auth/better-auth#11438 (1.7.8): a provider's issuer must exactly match its discovery document.
- **`@better-auth/scim`** better-auth/better-auth#11644 (1.7.8): attributes sent in non-standard case (`Active: false`) were ignored, so a deprovisioned user could stay active.
- **core**:
  - better-auth/better-auth#11626 (1.7.8): password reset and change revoke sessions in one transaction.
  - better-auth/better-auth#11646 (1.7.8): a failed reset no longer consumes the link or OTP.
  - better-auth/better-auth#11925 (1.7.12): the JWT plugin verifies with the stored key's algorithm.

## Behaviour changes the lift must measure, not assume

- **1.7.7 better-auth/better-auth#11494**: Magic Link and OAuth-state verification rows now carry `magic-link:` / `auth-state:` identifier prefixes.
  - In-flight Magic Link, OAuth, SAML and account-linking flows fail after the upgrade.
  - `implicit-account-linking.ts` writes its own `sys_verification` rows under its own identifier namespace. Confirm that it neither collides with nor reads the new prefixes.
- **1.7.8 better-auth/better-auth#11391**: `customSession` now throws when the session lookup fails, instead of treating the user as signed out. plugin-auth mounts `customSession`.
- **1.7.8 better-auth/better-auth#11540** (cookie attributes per RFC 6265bis), **better-auth/better-auth#10591** (stale-cookie clearing with `customSession`) and **better-auth/better-auth#11718** (`storeSessionInDatabase` session switching). plugin-auth sets session `storeInDatabase` whenever a host supplies `secondaryStorage`.
- **1.7.7 better-auth/better-auth#11375**: the active organization refreshes after sign-in when a session hook selects it. plugin-auth stamps `activeOrganizationId` in `session.create.before`.
- **`@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.9 better-auth/better-auth#10799**: the DPoP `htu` value is now derived from the public `baseURL`.
- **`@better-auth/oauth-provider` 1.7.10 better-auth/better-auth#11724**: a PKCE verifier mismatch moves from 401 to 400. Any test that pins the old status needs updating to the new one.
- **Export surface**: this family has removed public exports in a patch release before (1.7.3, see the overrides note in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`). `pnpm check:vendor-export-contract` is the gate.
- **Re-measure the version attestations**: 32 lines across 19 files under `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src` name `1.7.3`. Re-measure each claim on 1.7.12 and update its version stamp. A claim that no longer holds is reported, not quietly re-stamped.

## Acceptance

1. **One commit lifts all 16 pins.** The 11 family overrides in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and the 5 exact ranges in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json` all move to `1.7.12`, exact, not caret.
2. **Lockfile regenerated** with the repo's tooling, never by hand.
3. **Gates green**:
   - `pnpm check:override-consistency`
   - `pnpm check:vendor-export-contract`
   - the plugin-auth suite
   - the auth dogfood suites
4. **Each behaviour change above** is either re-measured, with a test or dogfood run cited in the PR body, or reported as a fork with the differing measurement.
5. **A `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`**, because the declared range reaches consumers. Its operator notes say:
   - in-flight Magic Link / OAuth / SAML flows must restart after the upgrade;
   - an OIDC SSO provider whose issuer does not exactly match its discovery document must be reconfigured.

## Out of scope

- **The 1.8.0 betas.**
- **Org invite links**: 1.7.4 to 1.7.12 add none. The organization plugin's only changes are better-auth/better-auth#11375, better-auth/better-auth#11637 and better-auth/better-auth#10866.
- **The cloud pin**: the cloud repo picks the lift up on its standing `.objectstack-sha` bump.
